mapper.select: select id, tenant_id, area_code, area_name, parent_id, area_type, site_id, risk_level, major_hazard_flag, sort_no, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_area where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0

select id, tenant_id, area_code, area_name, parent_id, area_type, site_id, risk_level, major_hazard_flag, sort_no, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_area where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'ENABLED' and deleted = 0

select id, tenant_id, area_code, area_name, parent_id, area_type, site_id, risk_level, major_hazard_flag, sort_no, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_area where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and area_code = #{code} and deleted = 0

select id, tenant_id, area_code, area_name, parent_id, area_type, site_id, risk_level, major_hazard_flag, sort_no, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_area where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0 order by parent_id asc, sort_no asc, id asc
mapper.update: update base_area set area_name = #{areaName}, parent_id = #{parentId}, area_type = #{areaType}, site_id = #{siteId}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, major_hazard_flag = #{majorHazardFlag}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
update base_area set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
update base_area set deleted = 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
